metadata.command: run.py --model vgg19_bn --reps 250 --seed 0 --save-run results/vgg19-bn-r250-s0 --notes VGG-19 + BatchNorm depth profile, 61 taps. Identical topology and ReLU count to vgg19; BN is affine in eval so it adds no gates, only moves the operating point. Tests whether lambda through the conv stack is set by the operating point rather than the rectifier count. --figures out/ --layers all
